api_checks.description: POST /api/auth/login seeded customer1; expect 200, expires_in 1800, role CUSTOMER
POST /api/auth/login wrong password for known and unknown email; expect 401 UNAUTHENTICATED, identical bodies, no token
GET /api/auth/me with no header and with a 1801s-old token; expect 401 each
GET /api/audit with CUSTOMER token; expect 403 FORBIDDEN
GET /openapi.json -> 200; enumerate the app route table; every route but POST /api/auth/login and GET /health has the auth dependency
POST /api/applications with PAN ABCDE1234F and Aadhaar 1234 5678 9012 (success and a 422 error path); scan captured logs for ABCDE1234F, 123456789012, 1234 5678 9012; expect none
POST /api/applications/{id}/documents {type, filename salary_slip_jan.pdf}; capture logs; expect the document id present and the filename absent
GET /api/_test/boom -> 500 (test-only route raising an unhandled exception); expect error envelope with no stack trace, and a JSON log line holding the redacted trace
GET /health with no token; expect 200 {"status":"ok"} in at most 1000 ms
POST /api/applications/1/underwrite -> 200 for age 40, income 100000.00, no flags; expect score 740 in the decision
POST /api/applications/1/underwrite -> 200 for age 30/60000.00/no flags (score 680); repeat for age 30/30000.00/prior_default (score 500)
POST /api/applications/1/underwrite -> 200; repeat the scoring on identical inputs 100 times (via fresh applications); expect one distinct score
POST /api/applications/1/underwrite -> 200 from the 680 baseline, varying one input each; expect 700, 690, 620, 640, 530
POST /api/applications/1/underwrite -> 200 for age 18/0.00/all flags (350) and age 40/150000.00 and 500000.00 (790)
